subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is/are FALSE with respect to simple model of the circular flow of economy?

i. The aggregate consumption is more than the aggregate expenditure.

ii. There is government intervention.

iii. There are no trade activities with the rest of the world.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only i**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The basic circular flow model of the economy **operates without government intervention.
 
• This model illustrates the interconnected flow of money, goods, and services among economic participants.
 
• It serves as the foundation for national accounting and macroeconomics.
 
• Additional details about the **circular flow model** include:
 
 
• It delineates the overall structure of the economy, depicting exchanges between households and firms through both the factor and product markets.
 
• Households contribute land, labor, and capital to firms.
 
• Households purchase goods and services from firms in the product market.
 
• Firms compensate households for the resources they supply, which constitute factors of production.
 
• In reality, the model becomes more intricate with the inclusion of two additional elements: government involvement.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Various circular flow models exist, each tracking a different number of sectors. 
 
• The following sectors could be incorporated into a circular flow model. Typically, each sector is denoted by a capital letter, often associated with GDP calculation methods. 
 
• Governments determine their gross national income by monitoring all injections into and withdrawals from the circular flow of income. When leaks match injections, the circular flow of income for a nation is deemed balanced.
